messages:

Subject: Pre-contract security ask: SOC 2 / DPA / HIPAA scope

Hi Hannah & Ben,

Thanks for the call earlier — we wanted to capture a few items so our procurement & security teams can kick off the pre-contract work. High-level asks: 

- Can you provide your most recent SOC 2 Type II report and the evidence retention period?
- We need a drafted DPA and want to understand which SCC module you expect to sign (ClearHealth is the controller; please confirm Redwood's role).
- We process PHI in our workflows — is Redwood able to sign a BAA / support HIPAA compliance? If not, what are the implications?
- We attached our vendor security questionnaire — can you confirm a primary point-of-contact for questions and an estimated turnaround (we're hoping for completed answers within 7 business days).

Attached: ClearHealth_Security_Questionnaire_20261110.pdf

Timeline: Procurement aims to finalize the contract by 20 Nov if possible.

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Pre-contract security ask: SOC 2 / DPA / HIPAA scope

Hi Maya — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

1) SOC 2: attaching our latest SOC 2 Type II summary (Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf). We retain evidence & audit logs for 12 months by default; longer retention can be discussed if required.

2) DPA & SCC module: Redwood's standard position is Processor (we process requests on behalf of customers who are Controller). For EU transfers, we typically propose the Controller-to-Processor SCC (module 2 under the EU SCC framework). I'm attaching a proposed DPA/SCC draft for your review (Proposed_DPA_SCC_Module2.docx).

3) HIPAA / BAA: because you indicated PHI is involved, Marissa (legal) — can you confirm Redwood's BAA stance and any required scoping language? My understanding is we can accommodate a BAA for customers with qualifying enterprise arrangements, but need legal sign-off on the exact wording and controls.

4) Questionnaire & MAP: Ben will own the questionnaire completion. Ben — can you take point and propose a mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones? Our suggested timeline: questionnaire answers in 5 business days, finalize DPA via DocuSign by 20 Nov.

Next steps:
- Ben to start filling questionnaire and flag any questions to ClearHealth security.
- Marissa to confirm BAA availability and any redline guardrails.
- I'll share the DocuSign link for the DPA once legal confirms.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf, Proposed_DPA_SCC_Module2.docx

Thanks — Hannah
Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Pre-contract security ask: SOC 2 / DPA / HIPAA scope

Hannah / Ben / Maya — looping legal in with a short checklist and our recommended approach based on the information provided: 

Summary of legal position (preliminary):
- Role mapping: Redwood = Processor, ClearHealth = Controller for customer data, including PHI. That mapping supports using the Controller-to-Processor SCC (Module 2).
- DPA: Attached is our standard DPA with Module 2 language; we can accept narrow, data-flow-specific redlines but will push back on broad changes that affect core operational controls.
- BAA / HIPAA: Redwood can enter a BAA where the customer requires HIPAA coverage and the commercial terms permit it. We will need to: 
  - Confirm the specific categories of PHI and processing activities (e.g., de-identification, retention, deletion windows).
  - Add BAA-specific safeguards (audit rights, right to inspect subprocessor list).
- SOC 2: We'll provide the full SOC 2 Type II report under NDA if needed; summary and control mappings are attached.

Requested items from ClearHealth to proceed:
1) Data flow diagram showing where PHI enters ClearHealth systems vs what is sent to Redwood (high-level is fine).
2) Confirmation that ClearHealth is the data controller for the flows requiring HIPAA coverage.
3) Any required data residency constraints (we default to multi-region inside US; EU constraints may change SCC routing).

Doc & evidence we can share now: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (summary); Proposed_DPA_SCC_Module2.docx

If ClearHealth confirms controller role + the PHI categories, we'll produce a BAA addendum and a DocuSign-ready DPA package (expect 1-2 business days to prepare once we have the data flow and confirmation).

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
